# SEIF4D — Developer & Product Builder

Seif is a Cairo-based developer and product builder. This portfolio brings together web experiences, digital products and venture concepts.

Website: https://seif4d.com/
Contact: contact@seif4d.com
Languages: Arabic and English

## Selected work

- [Harmed](https://seif4d.com/work/harmed.html): A medical apparel web and brand experience that brings clinical clarity together with a contemporary visual character.
- [Via Cairo](https://seif4d.com/work/via-cairo.html): A bilingual travel product designed to turn discovering Cairo into a clear, mobile-first digital journey.
- [Qurani](https://seif4d.com/work/qurani.html): A focused Arabic reading experience built around clarity, responsive interaction and respectful visual restraint.
- [DRAGON](https://seif4d.com/work/dragon.html): A proposed learning ecosystem focused on helping emerging developers move from repeated tutorials to real building practice.
- [SCOPE](https://seif4d.com/work/scope.html): A studio direction for researching opportunities, shaping focused products and turning selected ideas into testable builds.
- [VOLT](https://seif4d.com/work/volt.html): A service-focused web presence structured to make the offer easier to understand and the next action easier to take.

Project covers are AI-generated concept artwork, not product screenshots. See each project page for its status and available public links.
